info.scaling.body:
Enlarges the image in whole-number steps.
Keeps pixels even; borders may remain.
Off lets the image fill more of the screen.
Changes apply immediately.
To undo, select the opposite value.
Global follows Display settings.

info.boot.body:
Replaces the early BaseOS splash with Rondo.
On uses the Rondo logo.
Off restores the saved original.
Visible on the next power-on.
The library opens without a second splash.
Unavailable on unsupported devices.
info.language.title: Language
info.language.body:
Choose the language used by Rondo.
Applies after confirmation.
Select English to return to English.
info.timezone.title: Time zone
info.timezone.body:
Choose a country, then a city.
Left/Right jumps by letter; {pages} turns pages.
The check marks the saved choice. Dates stay in UTC.
Back cancels; Apply saves. The system clock is unchanged.
info.brightness.title: Brightness
info.brightness.body:
Left/Right changes screen brightness immediately in steps of 5%.
The setting is retained after restart.
The lowest value keeps the screen visible.
info.sound.title: Volume
info.sound.body:
Left/Right changes volume immediately in steps of 5%.
The volume buttons work in the library and in games.
This controls game audio, separately from the system mixer.
info.lid.title: Sleep on lid close
info.lid.body:
On: closing the lid enters sleep. Off: closing does not suspend the device.
Wake on lid open is a separate setting. A short Power press enters sleep in the library and games.
The game pauses and SRAM is flushed before sleep; audio and input are restored after wake.

info.slots.title: Saved states
info.slots.body:
Each row shows the saved date and time in your Rondo time zone.
Select a row to see its screenshot.
Older states have no screenshot until saved again.
Overwriting replaces that state; empty rows create a new one.
info.battery.title: Battery display
info.battery.body:
The icon fills with the measured charge level.
A bolt marks charging; a slash marks unavailable data.
This option only shows or hides the percentage.
The icon stays visible. Low charge is highlighted.
info.lid_wake.title: Wake on lid open
info.lid_wake.body:
On: opening the lid wakes the sleeping device. Off: open the lid and press Power.
Sleep on lid close is independent. An opening transition is required: an already open lid does not cancel Power sleep.
Experimental RG34XXSP feature requiring the matching kernel adapter. If unavailable, Power wake remains active.
wifi.error.password_format: Use 8–63 ASCII characters or a 64-digit hex key
wifi.error.unsupported: This network security is not supported
info.wifi.title: Wi-Fi
info.wifi.body:
Enable Wi-Fi and open Wi-Fi networks to search. Open and WPA/WPA2-Personal networks are supported. Select a known network to reconnect, disconnect or forget it.
Passwords use 8–63 ASCII characters or a 64-digit hex key. Use the on-screen keyboard, or type on a desktop keyboard. Enter connects; Esc cancels. Passwords stay masked and are excluded from logs and screenshots.
A connection is confirmed after association and an IP address; this does not guarantee internet access. Network credentials are stored separately on the card, which can be read by someone with physical access.
Wi-Fi settings are available from the library. The game uses the same connection. Radio settings are restored after restart.
The main Wi-Fi page shows the current network and IP address. The header is hidden when Wi-Fi is off. Connected signal levels use current RSSI; unavailable measurements do not show full strength.
clock.title: Date & time
clock.error.timeout: No confirmation from the time server
clock.error.save: Cannot save time preferences or history
info.clock.title: Date & time
info.clock.body:
Automatic sync updates the system clock when a network is available and restores this choice after restart. Synchronize now requests a fresh update; it also works when automatic sync is off. A connection to Wi-Fi is required, but internet access and the time server may still be unavailable.
Success is shown only after a time-service event and a synchronized kernel clock. The last successful time is displayed in the selected time zone. Time-zone selection is on the Date & time page.
BaseOS also attempts to store UTC in the hardware clock. Retention after complete power-off requires a device check. Enabling sync does not mean it has succeeded.
Set date & time works offline in the selected time zone. Left/right selects a date/time part; up/down changes its value. Apply confirms the entire date/time. Apply disables automatic sync, sets seconds to zero and verifies the system and UTC hardware clocks. Cancel discards edits. Years 2020–2099 are supported. Nonexistent or ambiguous times during daylight-saving transitions are rejected; choose another time. Automatic sync can be enabled again separately.

debug.confirm:
Clear Rondo diagnostic logs?
Games, saves and settings are kept.
When logging is on, new logs will be created.
info.debug.title: Diagnostics
info.debug.body:
Debug mode is off by default. Logs are stored in RondoState/Logs on the SD card.
Errors: failed operations and storage errors. Events: also controls, screen state and sleep/resume. Detailed: also raw battery and USB observations (changes or once a minute).
Files rotate automatically. If the card stops accepting writes, a bounded RAM copy is kept and copied to the card when writing recovers. RAM data is lost at shutdown if writing never recovers.
Logs do not contain network names, passwords or ROM paths. Clear logs removes Rondo diagnostic journals, including RAM copies and older battery journals; games, saves and settings are kept.
slot.delete_body:
Only this slot and its backup will be deleted.
Other slots and in-game saves remain.
bt.title: Bluetooth
bt.error.pair: Pairing failed; PIN entry is not supported yet
info.bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
info.bluetooth.body: Experimental: Micro D can connect, but its buttons do not work on the tested handheld. Enable Bluetooth, search, then select a device to pair or connect. Pairing with no PIN entry is supported. Devices requiring a PIN or numeric confirmation are not supported yet. Pairing data is stored by BaseOS. The last selected paired device is reconnected after restart or sleep. Forget requires confirmation. Connection does not prove audio output or game-controller support; those profiles need separate device testing.

info.system_power.title: Shut down and restart
info.system_power.body: Rondo closes before the system shuts down or restarts. Wait until the console is fully off before removing the SD card. Holding Power may cut power before writes finish.
info.game_background.title: Game background
info.game_background.body:
Color of the borders around the game image.
Black by default.
The game image and menu colors are unchanged.

startup.title: Continue the last game?
info.autosave.title: Automatic save
info.autosave.body:
A separate state is saved when leaving a game.
Manual slots are unchanged.
On failure, retry or explicitly exit without it.
Abrupt power loss does not save progress.
info.startup_resume.title: Resume on startup
info.startup_resume.body:
Offer the last game after startup.
Play starts only after confirmation.
You can go directly to the library.
Unavailable games are skipped.
info.idle_screen.title: Menu screen timeout
info.idle_screen.body:
The timer applies to menus, not active gameplay.
The default is 5 minutes; Off disables the timer.
The first press only restores the display.
Brightness and selection are retained.
info.battery_warning.title: In-game battery warnings
info.battery_warning.body:
A small battery and percentage in the game corner for 3 seconds.
Once at 10%, once at 5%.
Hidden in menus, while charging and on read failure.
Warnings rearm after charging to at least 20%.
This is a system estimate, not calibration.
